meta.what: indigoshell's design tokens, read from the code by prototypes/visuals/render_design.py --tokens; see docs/design/README.md
meta.units: px are Skia pixels at 96 DPI; points convert as pt x 96/72
meta.colors: hex #RRGGBB; 'alpha' 0..1 where the code applies one
meta.inline: a source ending '(inline)' is a value written in place in that function, not a named constant

BASE_BLACK.role: every background: both bars, toasts, the cards' fill (60%), Flux's window

BASE_SHADOW.role: a lifted black for a recessed card (rare)

BASE_GUTTER.role: unlit meter cells, the low-urgency toast frame, action-button fill

BASE_SURFACE.role: hover fill behind the INDIGO tag

BASE_MUTED.role: the muted tone: secondary text (dates, IPs, units, key hints, tabs behind)

MAGENTA_DIM.role: unlit magenta cells: empty workspaces, empty tray/battery cells, cava at rest

MAGENTA_MID.role: plain neon foreground: network name, Flux host, hovered tab title, ♫

MAGENTA_BRIGHT.role: the user, focus, emphasis: YOU, current tab, summaries, row labels

MAGENTA_BLOOM.role: magenta lifted to white: tag pulse peak, a tab loading, the send comet

YELLOW_FAINT.role: faint yellow ground: inline code bg, menu separators

YELLOW_DIM.role: occupied workspaces, the turn clock, code blocks, 'queued'

YELLOW_MID.role: the // key marker, the warn role, an info step's !

YELLOW_BRIGHT.role: values, caps, attention: readouts, the cap line, armed rows, ASK

CYAN_FAINT.role: defined, unused (its rgba twin backs the speedtest button)

CYAN_DIM.role: quiet cyan structure: meter brackets, unlit cells, dividers

CYAN_MID.role: data at rest: song title, lyric, KEY labels, host octet, row tags

CYAN_BRIGHT.role: interactive and info: borders, //, selection, links, clock; sent / up

CYAN_BLOOM.role: cyan lifted to white: the lyric's beat flash, matched letters when selected

LIME_BRIGHT.role: OK / received / go: received / down, ok role, GREENLIGHT, ON, online

VIOLET.role: RAM label, a finished job's cells

VIOLET_BRIGHT.role: the agent: its frame, chip, plate tint; RAM; volume; toast body

ERROR.role: errors and alarms only: failed, hot, critical, SCRUB, urgent, muted, ring

HUD_FG.role: body text on plates: steps, details (blue-grey, not neon)

HUD_FG_BRIGHT.role: bright body text: the reply, typed text, row titles; the raster leans to it

HUD_PLATE.role: the active tab's plate in a panel's tab strip

BAR_RULE.role: defined; the default config's bars draw no rule (WindowSpec.rule is None)

AGENT_ACCENT.role: the desktop agent's colour (= VIOLET_BRIGHT); a hub agent uses its voice's colour instead

PLATE_BASE.role: a plate's base before its tint

PLATE_TINT.note: share the base is pulled toward the speaker's colour

LILAC_FILL.role: the agent's plate while Lilac speaks

drop_reject.role: a row that cannot be picked, flashed

ROLE_COLORS.note: colour roles an app may name; 'voice:<id>' gives that voice's colour

sent_up.role: sent / up everywhere: the bar's upper light, the panel's up rate, the speedtest's UP

received_down.role: received / down everywhere: the bar's lower light, the panel's down rate, the speedtest's DN

ramp.note: steps by share of the scale: the bar's TEMP, the hardware panel's disk and GPU temperature; red = hot

temp_scale.note: empty to full; so yellow from 60 degC, red from 78 degC

family.note: FiraCode Nerd Font Mono: monospace, regular + bold, no italic face (the call skews regular by -0.2)

px_per_pt.note: sizes are Skia pixels; a size quoted in points is pt x 96/72

advance_em.note: every glyph one cell wide; measured at FONT_SIZE (10.00 px at 16 px)

FONT_SIZE.note: names: network, tabs, menu/tray rows, inputs

meter_value.note: bold: the 'values' size the user keeps

typography.line_height_note: descent - ascent of the font at that px size (text.line_height)

corners.note: the 45-degree cuts; every bevel in the shell uses these two, except the top bar's tab boxes (top-right only)

bevel.inset_rule: a path d px inside a bevel keeps parallel cuts with bevel - d(2 - sqrt 2) (style.bevel_at)

stroke.inset_rule: strokes sit inside their shape: inset by half the width (shapes.beveled(inset=)); the call adds 0.5 px (style.frame_inset)

call_plate.note: an L on a square corner; on a 45-degree corner an arm, the cut, an arm (half arm each side)

cap_line.note: YELLOW_BRIGHT (config), one cell-row above the level, 2 px overhang each side

lit.note: one cell per registered app, over MAGENTA_DIM; info, not an error

segments.rule: cells are whole pixels: fixed tick width, the count derived from the span (meters._ticks)

light.note: every dot is this square: the network's lights, the firewall state, radio items, the call's device/session marks and list bullets, a line graph's newest sample (shapes.light / text_light); filled = on or current, a 1 px outline = off; beside text it sits centred in the cell, half the cap height above the baseline

label.value: max(8, round(0.17 x size)) bold, tracking 0.6 at >= 56 px

call.note: 16 px under the top bar (TOP_BAR_HEIGHT + 16), never over it

value.anchor: flush under the top bar, on BAR_BG, no edge

motion.rule: idle is still: nothing animates without an event; motion marks events (music playing, traffic, the agent working, a ring) and alarms

battery_event.note: a state change plays its motion this long, then still

battery_motion_steps.note: only for EVENT_S after a change

toast_timeout_normal.note: the frame's timer trace runs round it clockwise

media_glitch_burst.note: while playing only: characters become 0/1 in GLITCH_PALETTE

ring.note: (ms, visible) frames, looped: urgent workspace, the call's blink

network_blink.note: square wave, log-mapped from byte rate

effects_appear.value: linear in wall-clock time (appear = elapsed / duration); the shaders shape it with smoothstep

panel_spawn.note: ScanLock: bands snap in out of order with a sideways tear and an RGB split; per-row lock = smoothstep(thr, thr + 0.18, appear); fade in smoothstep(0, 0.12, appear); jitter re-rolled 28/s; seed re-rolled per spawn. band_px/tear_px/split_px override rows/tear (left at their defaults)

lyric_reveal.note: GlitchWipe: spark = CYAN_BLOOM, cursor = MAGENTA_BRIGHT (as 0..1 rgb)

reply_reveal.note: per streamed chunk; spark CYAN_BRIGHT, cursor VIOLET_BRIGHT, its own bar off; a 2 px lead bar in the voice's colour with a 22 px glow (BAR_GLOW_PX)

holo.raster_note: 1 px line every RASTER_PITCH px on the window grid, its colour lerped RASTER_LIFT toward HUD_FG_BRIGHT; on holo windows POPUP_RASTER (cyan), composited SrcATop; on the call, per plate in its frame colour
holo.scan_note: tears in 9 px bands and 3 px slices of 24-120 px chunks; whole-pixel offsets; 10% of pieces drop to 25% at the band

decode_unused.note: available, not in the shipped config

color_split_unused.note: available, not in the shipped config

aberration_off.note: the always-on half of the braindance shader; off

scramble_unused.note: a character-swap reveal; available, not in the shipped config

efforts.note: what the call calls effort levels

mark.value: {name} is driving · press a key to take over
